changes.summary: Marked BF16 as an alternative to the FP8 default and made its text-only qualification boundary explicit.
changes.details: The immutable official checkpoint and runtime contract are unchanged. Bounded text chat is qualified; Spark vision serving remains unproven.

changes.summary: Migrated to the official vLLM 0.28.0 ARM64 release image and pinned the changed batch and CUDA-graph defaults.
Routed non-root vLLM caches to the writable outputs mount.
Declared the model's native multimodal, vision, reasoning, and agentic capabilities.
Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.

changes.summary: Initial reviewed catalog release of Qwen3.8 27B BF16 vLLM single Spark.
